thread:
Maria (oncall): FYI - seeing a sudden uptick in TLS handshake failures and 502 resets for hosted-api and realtime streams starting ~12:04 UTC. Really unusual pattern coincident with the cert rotation window. Spinning up incident doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1940000000.
SRE Bot: Alert fired: tls.handshake_error_rate > 4% (service=hosted-api, region=us-west-2). Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/edge/tls-handshakes?from=now-30m
Jake (infra): Rotation job (cert-rotator v0.20) applied a new chain to edge LB at 12:03. Rolling that change back across edge nodes now.
Sophie (support): Receiving CS pings - currently 9 reports, two high-touch customers called out (AcmeCorp, OmniRetail). Prioritizing and sending interim guidance.
Leo (eng-runtime): Observed connection resets come from older TLS clients that reject the new chain order. If rollback isn't enough we can add a compatibility stack in the gateway.
Maria (oncall): Actioned: paused cert-rotator schedules globally and queued rollback to last-known-good cert. Estimated convergence ~8-12m. Please do not push new certs to edge manually.
Amanda (product): Drafting status page update & customer note. Proposed wording: "Intermittent TLS connection failures impacted some Hosted API customers. Mitigation underway; updates to follow." Thoughts?
Support Bot: Created ticket INC-2026-973 and attached connection dump and sample stack traces. Linked support tickets: #2401, #2402, #2403.
Jake (infra): us-west rollback completed at 12:16 UTC; eu rollback in progress. Metrics show handshake errors dropping to baseline in us-west by 12:21.
Sophie (support): Notified enterprise contacts with a targeted message and provided retry/backoff advice.
Leo (eng-runtime): We're collecting client hello data (TLS versions/ciphers/SAN info) to identify affected client stacks. Attaching logs to the incident doc.
Maria (oncall): Preliminary RCA: cert-rotator templating changed SAN ordering which triggers failures on some legacy TLS implementations.
Maria (oncall): Next steps: pin cert-rotator version, add a canary rotation (1% traffic) with automatic rollback threshold on tls.errors, and add pre-rotation validation for chain ordering. Scheduling postmortem in next 24h: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/INC/1940000000/postmortem.
Amanda (product): I'll finalize the customer-facing message once RCA draft is ready.
Jake (infra): Follow-ups: add unit test for cert chain serialization and add rotation dry-run that runs against a dummy edge before prod.
Maria (oncall): Marking incident as mitigated for now. If anyone sees new spikes or customer-facing issues, ping this thread and escalate. :white_check_mark:
